role_voices.text_zh: 福爾摩斯的房間我去見過了，相當乾淨啊。咦？要等華生放假的時候去嗎？
role_voices.text_en: I've been to Sherlock's room before, and it was actually very clean. Huh? Are you suggesting we should go when Watson's on holiday?

role_voices.text_zh: 這金屬光澤真是迷人……姆嗯嗯♥我親愛的小寶貝——呀！魔、魔王？！你怎麼會在這裡！
role_voices.text_en: This metallic luster is so captivating... Mmm-hmm♥ My dear little treasure—Aah! A-Archfiend?! What are you doing here!

role_voices.text_zh: 唔嗯嗯……魔王的鼻息，在我的肩頸處…呀嗯！好癢！
role_voices.text_en: Mmm... I can feel Archfiend's breath on my neck and shoulders... ah! It tickles!

role_voices.text_zh: 為了你、啊嗯！剛剛特別去運動了一下……唔嗯嗯、現在，全身都是汗味，呀嗯♥
role_voices.text_en: For you... mmph! I just did a little exercise... Mmm, and now I'm all... stinky with sweat... kyaa♥
None of you are getting away!

role_voices.text_zh: 這就是，我作為火槍手的榮譽！
role_voices.text_en: This is my honor as a musketeer!

role_voices.text_zh: 各位，抱歉……拖到你們的…後腿了……
role_voices.text_en: Everyone, I'm sorry…I held all of you back...

role_voices.text_zh: 這是我們的勝利！我為人人，人人為我！
role_voices.text_en: This is our victory! One for all, and all for one!
